title: Cloudflare Access adds passkeys and Workers gets an experimental Codex harness
summary: Cloudflare adds passkey sign-in to protected web apps and shows how a Codex agent can recover work after a Durable Object restarts.
imageAlt: A browser sign-in window with a key beside an agent timeline with a replay arrow
imageCaption: Original illustration of passkey sign-in and replayable agent events.

sections.heading: Passkeys come to protected web apps
paragraphs: On November 6, Cloudflare announced passkey sign-in for applications behind Access and for its App Launcher. A user first verifies their identity through an existing method, then enrolls a passkey. Administrators choose which apps accept passkeys, and Access policies still decide who can enter.

For a team sharing a protected preview site, enrollment and routine sign-in are distinct parts of the user journey. A first visit on a device without the enrolled credential can feel different from a return visit where the browser can offer a saved passkey.

sections.heading: Cloudflare experiments with a Codex agent that can resume work
paragraphs: On November 9, Cloudflare published an experimental Agents SDK example that adapts Codex’s Rust turn processing to WebAssembly in a Durable Object. It saves conversations and files, reuses recorded model and tool results after a restart, and stores ordered events that a client can replay when it reconnects.

For a browser interface showing a long agent run, replay can fill gaps in the activity feed after a disconnect. Cloudflare says interrupted steps can run again, so an integration that writes to an external service needs to account for repeat attempts.

zh-TW.title: Cloudflare Access 加入通行金鑰，Workers 展示 Codex 代理實驗範例
zh-TW.summary: Cloudflare 讓受保護的網站支援通行金鑰登入，也展示 Codex 代理如何在 Durable Object 重啟後接續工作。
zh-TW.imageAlt: 帶有鑰匙的瀏覽器登入視窗，旁邊是帶有重播箭頭的代理事件時間軸
zh-TW.imageCaption: 描繪通行金鑰登入與代理事件重播的原創插畫。

sections.heading: 受保護的網頁應用程式可用通行金鑰登入
paragraphs: Cloudflare 在 11 月 6 日宣布，受 Access 保護的應用程式與 App Launcher 可使用通行金鑰登入。使用者先透過既有方式驗證身分，再註冊通行金鑰。管理員可選擇哪些應用程式接受這種登入方式，存取權限仍由 Access 政策決定。
對分享受保護預覽網站的團隊而言，註冊與日常登入是兩個不同的流程。使用者透過尚無已註冊憑證的裝置首次造訪時，看到的步驟可能不同於瀏覽器可直接提供已儲存通行金鑰的回訪。

sections.heading: Cloudflare 展示可接續工作的 Codex 代理
paragraphs: Cloudflare 在 11 月 9 日發布 Agents SDK 的實驗範例，將 Codex 用 Rust 撰寫的回合處理程式移植到 WebAssembly，在 Durable Object 內執行。範例會儲存對話與檔案，在重啟後沿用已記錄的模型與工具結果，並保留依序排列的事件，讓客戶端重新連線時可以重播。
如果瀏覽器介面會顯示長時間執行的代理任務，重播事件可補上斷線期間遺漏的進度。Cloudflare 指出，中斷的步驟可能重新執行，因此若整合會寫入外部服務，就得考慮同一操作可能被重試。
